en.title: B-V-D-P
en.decryption: Order of administrative divisions from largest (Province/Bhukti) to smallest (City/Pura).

hi.title: B-V-D-P
hi.decryption: Order of administrative divisions from largest (Province/Bhukti) to smallest (City/Pura).

fact.en: Mistaking Gupta administration as highly centralized; in reality, it was more decentralized compared to the Mauryas.
fact.hi: Mistaking Gupta administration as highly centralized; in reality, it was more decentralized compared to the Mauryas.

fact.en: Assuming 'Vishayapati' were hereditary; they were often appointed by the Provincial Governor (Uparika).
fact.hi: Assuming 'Vishayapati' were hereditary; they were often appointed by the Provincial Governor (Uparika).

fact.en: Confusing 'Agraharas' (land grants to Brahmins) with 'Devagraharas' (grants to temples).
fact.hi: Confusing 'Agraharas' (land grants to Brahmins) with 'Devagraharas' (grants to temples).
